test_selection: One directed RV32 program executes the same cached instruction line in a 64-iteration loop, and six upstream RISC-V Architectural Tests provide additional complete-CPU execution. In cv32a60x, these refills and later cache hits pass through the technology-cut sram_cache data arrays with BYTE_ACCESS=0 and USER_EN=1.

reconstruction.test_sources: checkout the recorded RISC-V Architectural Tests revision for the six named tests and copy harness/icache_sram_reuse.S, SHA-256 80e684d5bf77f25d31386a2f898ef50a24f4f0f41003fac6527dfb2b01cce4df, as the recorded directed test source

selected_user_test.observations: 128 initialized reads compare data and nonzero user through external ports after full-word writes and after an unselected write enable asserts with different inputs.
selected_user_test.timeout_classification: A wall-clock timeout is INVALID (2); a build failure, an abnormal end or an incomplete record is FAIL (1); only completed matching output is PASS (0).
selected_user_test.reconstruction: Read the reference and both dependencies directly from cpu_revision Git objects into the private log directory; verify every source SHA; preserve original headers.
selected_user_test.build_failure_classification: A missing sram_cache module or a build failure produces the standard candidate compile receipt and exits 1. A tool or resource failure, signal termination or timeout exits 2.
